asset_type: IQON supplement product page benefits photograph
objective: Create one extremely believable premium editorial photograph for an IQON supplement website, matching restrained skincare material photography in cool gray, silver and ivory. This is a format illustration; no efficacy or before-and-after message.

canvas.framing: One cohesive close-up photograph; safe focal point in central 70% so both square mobile and taller desktop crops work.

photographic_style.camera: Full-frame macro lens, 85mm equivalent, plausible shallow depth of field, physically believable perspective
photographic_style.lighting: Soft directional window light, gentle fill, controlled natural highlights and true contact shadows
photographic_style.rendering: Unretouched product editorial realism; subtle sensor grain; fine material detail; slight organic irregularity; no CGI perfection
photographic_style.palette: Cool gray, charcoal, ivory, brushed silver. Any accent is highly desaturated.

constraints: No text, logos, labels, captions, watermarks or UI.
No hands, faces, bodies, food decorations or plants.
Nothing floating; gravity and reflections must be physically plausible.
No oversized dose claims or exact serving measurement depicted.
No decorative abstract 3D blobs, glow effects, excessive gloss, perfect symmetry or plastic textures.

scene.subject: Three small ruby-red translucent supplement gummies shaped as rounded gumdrop domes with flat bases, resting naturally on a cool gray clear-glass plate. One foreground gummy sharply focused with tiny natural air bubbles and realistic tacky texture; two behind softer. Not sugar coated, not gummy bears, no fruit or food props.
